preview.title: Empero (@EmperoAI)
preview.description:
quark: a 165M-parameter language model with 128K context, post-trained with RL only. No SFT stage, no distillation.
The whole project, failed first design included, cost about $4,200 of compute (about 1,300 H100-hours).
Four open-weight models and a report…
